questions.question: What is the String in C# meant for?
questions.explanation: C# Supports a predefined reference type known as string. When we declare a string using string type we are declaring the object to be of type "System.String".

questions.question: What does the term 'immutable' means in term of string objects?

options.text: We can modify characters included in the string
We cannot modify characters contained in the string
We cannot perform various operation of comparison, inserting, appending etc

questions.explanation: String objects are 'immutable' means we cannot modify the characters contained in string. Also operation on string produce a modified version of string rather then modifying characters of string.
